summary: Full-stack testing of Bonmont Email Checker. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed (root welcome, single check-email returns 'invalid' for fake email, file upload batch, empty-file handling, checker-script download, validation 422). All endpoints make real requests to bonmont.com and responded within seconds, returning 'invalid' as expected. Frontend: all UI flows verified via Playwright - header, 4 stat cards, single email check with result badge + stats update, file upload (dropzone shows filename, batch check populates results table with 2 rows), search filter, filter buttons, CLI docs tabs (Script/Instructions), copy & download buttons. No errors found.
critical_code_review_comments: No persistence/MongoDB usage despite motor client being initialized - acceptable since app is a stateless utility, but the DB connection is unused dead code.
check-emails-file has no file-size or email-count limit; a large upload could trigger many real external requests to bonmont.com and long response times.
Single/batch endpoints create a fresh aiohttp session and re-extract nonce per request (expected for correctness).
seed_data_creation: None - app is stateless, no DB seeding needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App has no auth. Backend endpoints hit real bonmont.com; all test emails return 'invalid'. BASE_URL loaded from frontend/.env in backend_test.py since REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL isn't in backend shell env. All data-testids match the review request.
